reviewers: native implementer reviewing independently authored proof resolver
checks: Closed decoded command and verified current native actor before cached receipt; immutable result output, selected scoped grant and original binding/session provenance.
Expired unchanged authority requires explicit adoption; revoked, replaced, disabled or unknown producer authority quarantines unaccepted output. Accepted Changes remain immutable.
Independent current human review and current accountable human acceptance recheck exact Work contract and current shared Doc target/base.

Acceptance stages one real canonical Doc save plus one typed record; two attempt/event slots and combined core/proposal object bounds are required. Integrator must append typed record atomically or discard whole result.

Completion requires exact current Doc bytes/revision, actual native receipt and the exact adjacent typed accept/native save pair with matching request/result/actor/time/review/adoption and typed retained attempt. A direct save plus a forged accepted head cannot satisfy proof.
Bounded admission verifies exact 73-byte project/grant UUID key, actual proposal byte sum and SHA keys, record/count/ID/authentication/uint limits.

Fourteen source arms exercise review/revision, exact retries, stale/base/private access, comment independence, expiry/adoption/revocation, current reviewer/acceptor, deterministic internal request vector, capacity rollback, missing run resolver, existing Doc update and real completion proof negatives.
limitations: No native compilation or execution yet; source review and test definitions do not constitute a passing native gate.
No Home mark, HTTP route, saved-state successor or service principal is activated.
Compound history integration is a separate packet and must regenerate both acceptance events before exposing restored state.
Run admission defaults to unknown/denied; trusted positive run fixture is synthetic and does not prove a real agent run.
